tools.name: search_licensed_entities
tools.description: Check whether a company appears on official APAC regulator registers (HKMA, Japan FSA, Taiwan FSC) by name, brand or licence/corporate number. Returns status, source URL and as-of date. Not legal advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: get_licensed_entity
tools.description: Full register record for one entity id from search_licensed_entities, with source URL, as-of date and other registrations. Not legal advice. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: sanctions_check_wallet
tools.description: Check 1-25 comma-separated crypto wallet addresses against OFAC SDN/Consolidated listed digital currency addresses. Informational, not legal advice. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: sanctions_screen_name
tools.description: Fuzzy-screen a company, person, vessel or aircraft name (with aliases) against the OFAC SDN and Consolidated lists. Informational, not legal advice. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
